description: Termini inference network path selection. 'direct' is the frozen demo path (docs/contracts/infra-decisions.md D2 — underlay routing, no overlay). 'ovn' is the day-2 overlay and the documented fallback.

direct.description: Host-level underlay route to the llama.cpp host. No encapsulation, no OVN/fan, no bridge hop: the agent's egress is SNATed onto the underlay and routed straight to Node C. 'interface' is the node's underlay NIC (ens4 on the GCP demo images; rename per node). Node C is on-link on the underlay, so no next hop is set; add one only if the inference host is off-subnet.

ovn.description: OVN logical-router path carried over Geneve (UDP 6081) into the overlay. Day-2 overlay; fallback only. 50 bytes of outer headers (IPv4 20 + UDP 8 + Geneve 8 + inner Ethernet 14) are subtracted from the path MTU. The destination is on-link on the logical network, so no next hop is set.

notes: GCP VPC MTU is 1460, so on the demo VPC the same 50-byte walk-off applies to 1460 (direct) -> 1410 (ovn).
The lab (infra/net/lab) reproduces the on-prem profile on native Ethernet: 1500 direct, 1450 overlay.
Path MTU is the largest IP payload the path carries without fragmentation; the DF-bit probe payload is path_mtu - 28 (20 IP + 8 ICMP).
